n-k-k4-01.title: Chizivisiro chakapfupiswa
n-k-k4-01.goal: Enzanisa chidimbu chipfupi chemumwe wekirasi nechizivisiro chelaibhurari, tsvaga mitsara inochinja zvinotaurwa nechizivisiro, uye ururamise imwe.
n-k-k4-01.material:
'Mudzidzi mutsva wekirasi anobvunza 현우 kuti mitemo yelaibhurari ndeapi. 현우 anoverenga chizivisiro chiri pazasi uye anomunyorera chidimbu chipfupi.

[도서관 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 평일 오전 9시~오후 5시 / 토요일 오전 9시~낮 12시 / 일요일은 쉽니다.
- 책은 한 번에 5권까지, 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
- 늦게 반납하면 늦은 날 수만큼 책을 빌릴 수 없어요.
- 음료는 뚜껑이 있는 물병만 가지고 들어갈 수 있어요.'
n-k-k4-01.prereq.1: Unoziva 평일, 토요일, 일요일, 빌리다 ne돌려주다
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.prompt: Chidimbu cha현우 chiri pazasi. Mitsara imwe inoti chimwe chinhu chakasiyana nechizivisiro. Sarudza imwe yacho.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tora chidimbu mutsara mumwe panguva wotsvaga mutsara unoenderana pachizivisiro.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mutsara wega wega, bvunza: chizivisiro chinoti izvi chaizvo here, kana chidimbu chakachinja zuva, nguva yakareba kana mamiriro?
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.2: Tarisa mitsara ine zuva, nhamba yemazuva kana izwi re 'any'.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 2, 5 ne6 haina kururama. Chizivisiro chinoti 일요일은 쉽니다 (rakavharwa neSvondo), kurambidzwa kukwereta kunogara mazuva akaenzana nekunonoka kwebhuku, uye bhodhoro remvura rine chivharo chete ndiro rinobvumirwa. Mitsara 1, 3 ne4 inoenderana nechizivisiro.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.prompt: Mutsara wekupedzisira wechidimbu unonzwika pfupi uye une hushamwari. Nei zvichinetsa mudzidzi mutsva?
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mutsara 6 padivi pemutsara wekupedzisira wechizivisiro.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga izwi diki muchizivisiro rinodzikamisa zvinwiwa zvinobvumirwa, uone kuti chidimbu chaichengeta here.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.a: Achafunga kuti haabvumirwi kuuya nechinwiwa zvachose.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.a: Chidimbu hachirambidzi zvinwiwa; chinobvumira chinwiwa chega chega, izvo zvakapesana nekukanganisa.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.b: Achafunga kuti zvinwiwa zvinobvumirwa pamazuva evhiki chete.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.b: Chidimbu hachitaure chinhu nezvemazuva ezvinwiwa. Dambudziko ndiro mamiriro asipo ekuti chinwiwa chipi.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.c: Anogona kuuya nechinwiwa chisingabvumirwi, nokuti mamiriro akadonhedzwa.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.d: Achafunga kuti laibhurari inomubvumira kuuya nechikafu pamwe nezvinwiwa.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.d: Mutsara unotaura zvinwiwa chete; chikafu hachitaurwi mairi.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.explain: Chidimbu chinogona kuva chisina kururama pasina izwi rimwe rakashata: 아무거나 yakabvisa mamiriro (뚜껑이 있는 물병만). Mamiriro anodonhedzwa nzira yakajairika yekuchinja mutemo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsara wezvinwiwa (mutsara wekupedzisira wechidimbu) muchiKorea kuti utaure zvakafanana nechizivisiro. Shandisa kutaura kwemutsa -요.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dzokera kumutsara wekupedzisira wechizivisiro utsvage zvinwiwa zvinobvumirwa.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.1: Mamiriro api akarasika mumutsara wechidimbu? Adzorere.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wangu unochengeta zvose zviviri chivharo nebhodhoro remvura here?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mudzidzi mutsva anoverenga mutsara wangu chete angaunza chinhu chakarurama here?

n-k-k4-02.title: Keke yemahara yezuva rekuzvarwa?
n-k-k4-02.goal: Batanidza flaya nemeseji yeshamwari, ona kuti zvokwadi zvipi zvinosarudza kuti hurongwa hunoshanda here, uye udzidze shamwari yako zvekuita.
n-k-k4-02.material:
'Nhasi ndiChitatu (수요일). Shamwari yako 하나 yakatumira meseji, uye yakakupawo flaya yekafe.

[카페 봄날 생일 이벤트]
- 생일인 손님은 케이크 한 조각이 무료예요.
- 생일 3일 전까지 전화로 예약해 주세요. (예: 생일이 금요일이면 화요일까지)
- 일요일은 이벤트를 하지 않아요.
- 신분증을 가지고 오세요.

하나의 문자: "내 생일이 이번 주 토요일이야! 카페 봄날에서 무료 케이크 먹자. 예약은 나중에 할게."'
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.prompt: Ndezvipi zvidimbu ZVIVIRI zveruzivo zvinosarudza kuti hurongwa hwa하나 hunoshanda here? Sarudza zvose zviviri.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Zvokwadi zvipi, zvichitorwa pamwe chete, zvinokupa zuva?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa chokwadi chimwe nechimwe: chingaita kuti hurongwa huwanikwe husina kubudirira 하나 asati asvika kukafe here?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.b: Zuva rekuzvarwa ra하나 riri neMugovera, saka mutemo weSvondo hauna basa pahurongwa uhwu.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinofanira kuitwa kukafe, asi hazvisarudze kuti hurongwa hunogona kushanda here.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.e: Ichi ndicho chikonzero chehurongwa, kwete mutemo wekutarisa.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.explain: Mutemo wekuchengetedza nezuva rekuzvarwa zvinofanira kubatanidzwa: kuzvarwa kweMugovera pamwe ne 'kusvika mazuva 3 pamberi' kunopa nguva yekupedzisira, uye nguva yacho inogona kuva padyo.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.prompt: Shandisa muenzaniso weflaya. Nhasi ndiChitatu (수요일). Pazuva rekuzvarwa reMugovera, zuva rekupedzisira rekuchengetedza nderipi?
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa muenzaniso uri muflaya sechimiro: kubva pazuva rekuzvarwa, verenga shure nemazuva akaenzana.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mazuva nenhevedzano Mugovera, Chishanu, China, ... uye mira panhamba yakarurama.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.a: China ine mazuva 2 chete pamberi peMugovera, saka zvatonoshura.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.c: Chipiri chiri mazuva 4 pamberi peMugovera. Verenga nemuenzaniso: kuzvarwa kweChishanu kunopa Chipiri.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.d: Muvhuro uri mazuva 5 pamberi peMugovera; muenzaniso weflaya (kuzvarwa kweChishanu, Chipiri) unoratidza mazuva 3 pamberi.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.explain: Chishanu kusvika Chipiri mazuva 3 pamberi, saka Mugovera kusvika Chitatu ndiyo mugwagwa mumwe chete. Nhasi ndiChitatu, saka nhasi ndiro zuva rekupedzisira.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora meseji pfupi kuna 하나 muchiKorea (kutaura kwemutsa -요 kune hushamwari). Muudze zvekuita nekusvika riini, uye nei.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.1: Taura zvaanofanira kuita (chii, sei) uye wedzera chikonzero ne -아서/-어서 kana -니까.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Meseji yangu inotaura nhasi, zvekuita nechikonzero here?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 하나 aizoziva zvekuita mushure mekuiverenga here?

n-k-k4-03.title: Matikiti eboka
n-k-k4-03.goal: Shandura meseji yeshamwari ine mutemo wehukama wakavanzika kuita mamiriro chaiwo, vaka mabhoka akati akakodzera, uye uzivise rimwe muchiKorea.
n-k-k4-03.material:
'Shamwari yako 서연 inokutumira meseji usati watenga matikiti epaki yemitambo:

"놀이공원에 같이 가요. 어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요. 어린이도 한 명은 가야 해요. 모두 5명 이상 가고 싶어요. 표값은 모두 합쳐서 6만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요."

(1만 원 = 10,000원, so 6만 원 = 60,000원. Boka rakangova vakuru nevana vaunorondedzera.)

[표값]
어른 한 명: 10,000원
어린이 한 명: 6,000원'
n-k-k4-03.prereq.1: Unoziva nhamba, 명, 어른, 어린이 ne -까지
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.prompt: '어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요' inokuudza chii?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga waedza mutemo nemunhu mukuru mumwe: vana vangani vanogona kuuya?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wobva waedza vanhu vakuru vaviri uye uone kuti huwandu hunokura sei.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.a: Munhu mukuru mumwe anogona kutora vana vasingapfuuri vaviri.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.b: Munhu mukuru mumwe nomumwe anofanira kutora vana vaviri chaizvo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.b: '까지' inopa muganhu wepamusoro, kwete nhamba inodikanwa.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.c: Pangava nevana vakawanda sevanhu vakuru chete.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.c: Mutemo unoti vana vaviri kumunhu mukuru mumwe nomumwe, kwete mumwe.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.d: Mwana mumwe nomumwe anoda vanhu vakuru vaviri vanoenda naye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.d: Izvo zvinodzosera mutemo shure: pano munhu mukuru mumwe anogona kutora vana vaviri.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.explain: '-까지' inoisa muganhu: munhu mukuru mumwe anotora vana vasingapfuuri vaviri, saka nevanhu vakuru 2 vana vasingapfuuri 4 ndivo vanogona kuenda.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga mapoka 3 anokodzera mamiriro ose emeseji, rimwe nerimwe rine huwandu hwevanhu vakuru hwakasiyana. a = vanhu vakuru, c = vana.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mamiriro nemazwi ako pachako, mutsetse mumwe pamumwe.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga ne a = 2 uye utsvage huwandu hwevana hunogutsa mutemo wevana nemutemo wevanhu 5.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Munhu mukuru mumwe chete uye mwana mumwe chete kana kupfuura.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Unoda munhu mukuru mumwe kana kupfuura, uye meseji inoti mwana mumwe kana kupfuura (어린이도 한 명은).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Vasingapfuuri vana vaviri kumunhu mukuru mumwe nomumwe.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Vana vakawandisa: munhu mukuru mumwe nomumwe anogona kutora vana vasingapfuuri vaviri (어린이 두 명까지).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Meseji inoda vanhu 5 kana kupfuura (모두 5명 이상).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso vanhu vakuru 2 + vana 3 = 38,000 won; 3 + 3 = 48,000 won; 4 + 2 = 52,000 won. Mapoka mazhinji anokodzera nokuti meseji inopa miganhu, kwete boka rimwe chaiko.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza IMWE yemapoka ako uye utumire 서연 meseji pfupi muKorean (-요 ine hunhu): kutanga vanhu vakuru, wobva wavana, wobva watotal yemutengo. Nyora nhamba senhamba kana mazwi enhamba eKorean.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Shandisa boka rimwe kubva pamusoro: nhamba mbiri dzipi?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Taura vanhu vakuru, wobva wavana, wobva watotal mu won.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Huwandu huri mumeseji yangu hunoenderana neboka rimwe randakavaka here?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Total ndi10,000 × vanhu vakuru + 6,000 × vana here?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.prompt: Hama ya서연 inoti: '어른 5명이랑 어린이 2명이 가요. 모두 7명이고 5만 8천 원이에요.' Chirongwa ichi chinoputsa mamiriro api?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.0: Edza chirongwa nemamiriro ose emeseji, rimwe panguva.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.1: Itai kuverenga nemi pachenyu; musatsamira panhamba dzakanyorwa muchirongwa.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.a: Pane vana vakawandisa kupfuura zvinobvumirwa nemutemo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.a: Vanhu vakuru vashanu vanogona kutora vana vasingapfuuri gumi, uye chirongwa chine vaviri chete.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.b: Pane vanhu 7, saka mutemo wevanhu 5 wakasangana.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.c: Chirongwa chine vana 2, saka mutemo wemwana mumwe kana kupfuura wakasangana.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.d: Matikiti chaizvo anodhura 62,000 won, anopfuura muganhu.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.explain: Vanhu vakuru vashanu vanodhura 50,000 won uye vana vaviri vanodhura 12,000 won, iyo ndi62,000 won, inopfuura 60,000. Nhamba iri muchirongwa yakanganisa. Verenga total nguva dzose iwe pachako panzvimbo yekungoitevedzera.

n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
n-k-k4-04.title: Chipo chezvekudya zvidiki
n-k-k4-04.goal: Verenga kutaurirana pfupi nezvikamu, chinja kuverenga kwako sezvo mitsara mitsva ichisvika, wobva wapindura kuitira kuti hapana anofanira kufungidzira.
n-k-k4-04.material: Uri mudhinini yechikoro nehama yako yekirasi 지우. Unobudisa bhegi remabhisikiti.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe, sarudza kuverenga kunoratidzika kunogoneka zvikuru, wobva waenderera.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga mazwi anopa chikonzero kana nguva mushure mhinduro yekutanga.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuverenga kwose kuviri kunogoneka: 괜찮아요 inogona kubvuma kana kurambira chipo. Mhinduro imwe pfupi haikwani.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hapana chinotaura chimwe chikafu; ari kungopindura chipo chako.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mhinduro yake ipfupi uye ine hunhu, kwete mubvunzo.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino 지우 angada kureva chii zvikuru?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.after: '-아서요' inopa chikonzero. Kudya zvakawanda masikati kunoita kuti 'no thanks' ive kuverenga kwakanaka.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Angada mabhisikiti mashoma, nokuti akadya zvakawanda masikati.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Masikati makuru chikonzero chekusadya zvimwe, saka zvinonongedzera kurambira.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Anopindura nechikonzero chinobatana nekudya, saka akanzwa.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Zvino mufananidzo wose wakajeka: kwete izvozvi, asi pamwe hongu gare gare. 괜찮아요 yekutanga yoga yaisagona kuratidza izvozvo.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kwete izvozvi, asi pamwe bhisikiti rimwe gare gare.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Anokumbira rimwe gare gare, saka haarambire zvachose.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Anokumbira rimwe gare gare, saka anoda kuti uwachengete.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.reflect: 괜찮아요 inogona kureva 'yes, fine' kana 'no thanks'. Mazwi anouya mushure mayo (chikonzero, nguva) anosarudza kuti ndeipi. Mhinduro ine hunhu inogona kuramba isina kujeka.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yako 민호 inokupa chikafu chidiki. Mhinduro ipi 민호 angagona kunzwisisa zvisina kururama zviri nyore?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bvunza mhinduro imwe neimwe: mushure mekuiverenga, 민호 angaziva kuti akupe chikafu izvozvi here?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira mhinduro imwe neimwe mumeseji isina inzwi: 민호 angaiverenga nenzira mbiri dzakapesana here?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: 괜찮아요 yoga inogona kunzwiwa seyes kana kwete. Kurambira kana kugamuchira nezwi rakajeka (안 먹을게요, 주세요) hakugoni kunzwisiswa zvisina kururama.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.prompt: 민호 anokupa chikafu chidiki. Hauchidi izvozvi, asi ungachida gare gare. Pindura muKorean (kutaura kwe -요 kune hunhu) kuitira kuti 민호 asanzwisise zvisina kururama.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.0: Taura zvakajeka kuti hauzodya izvozvi uye upe chikonzero chipfupi.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.1: Wedzera mutsara mumwe pamusoro pezvauchaita gare gare.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: 민호 angaziva here kuti ndinoramba izvozvi?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 민호 angaziva here kuti ndingati hongu gare gare?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.modelNote.0: Inorambira izvozvi, inopa chikonzero, inokumbira gare gare.

n-k-k4-05.title: Kudzoka kumba mushure menguva: chirongwa chimwe, vaverengi vaviri
n-k-k4-05.goal: Taura nhau imwechete kuna ambuya vako nemukoma wako mudiki, uchichinja chikamu chekutaura cheKorean kune mumwe nomumwe.
n-k-k4-05.material: Une kudzidzira kwekirabhu nhasi uye uchadzoka kumba pa7:00, gare gare pane zvakajairika. Uchaisa zvinyorwa zvekuna ambuya vako (할머니), nemeseji yemukoma wako mudiki (동생), kwaunoshandisa 반말.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mameseji mutsara mumwe panguva uye utarise kuti mutsara mumwe nomumwe unopera sei.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa verb inoshandiswa kudya kwemanheru kwa할머니 nemagumo.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.a: Mitsara miviri inopera sezvaunotaura neshamwari kana munhu mudiki, kwete kuna 할머니.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.c: Mutsara wekutanga unotsvedza mukutaura kwakajairika (올게); mitsara miviri haienderani.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.d: Une hunhu, asi 먹어요 hairemekedze 할머니 sezvinoita 드세요 kudya kwake.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.explain: Kuna 할머니 mutsara mumwe nomumwe unoda -요 kana mugumo unoremekedza, uye kudya kwake kunotora verb inoremekedza 드세요. Magumo akajairika (가, 먹어, 올게) ndeeshamwari nevanhu vadiki, uye kusanganisa zvikamu zvekutaura mutsamba imwe kunonzwika sekusasarudza.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora tsamba yako kuna 할머니 muKorean. Taura kuti uchadzoka kumba pa7:00 uye nei.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekudaidza 할머니, wobva wataura nguva nechikonzero.
